en_title: Tom Holland Says Spider-Man 5 Is 'Unclear,' Teases He Knows When Miles Morales Will Join the MCU
cn_title: 汤姆·赫兰德称《蜘蛛侠5》未明
subtitle: 迈尔斯何时入MCU
opus_summary: 汤姆·赫兰德称《蜘蛛侠5》仍不明朗，却暗示知道迈尔斯·莫拉莱斯何时加入MCU。漫威和索尼尚未官宣第五部，但《蜘蛛侠：崭新之日》首映周末票房强劲，续作仍有空间。

paragraphs.en: Details regarding Spider-Man 5 are "unclear," according to Tom Holland, but the longtime Peter Parker actor has at least confirmed he knows when Miles Morales will join the Marvel Cinematic Universe (MCU).
paragraphs.cn: 据汤姆·赫兰德称，《蜘蛛侠5》的细节仍「不明朗」，但这位长期饰演彼得·帕克的演员至少确认，他知道迈尔斯·莫拉莱斯何时会加入漫威电影宇宙（MCU）。

paragraphs.en: The infamously leak-prone actor let a few details slip when promoting his new film, Spider-Man: Brand New Day . Although he was able to keep most of his cards to his chest, he couldn't help but bring up the topic on millions of Marvel fans' minds: Miles Morales.
paragraphs.cn: 这位出了名容易剧透的演员在宣传新片《蜘蛛侠：崭新之日》时，透露了几条细节。虽然他大部分时候都守口如瓶，却还是忍不住提到了数百万漫威粉丝都在关心的话题：迈尔斯·莫拉莱斯。

paragraphs.en: Holland immediately turned the conversation toward the fan-favorite Web-Slinger when asked, as a Spider-Man fan, what questions he had on his mind during an interview with 1Live . Was he willing to share a concrete answer regarding when Miles Morales will join the MCU? Well, no, but it sounds like things are moving quickly at Marvel.
paragraphs.cn: 在接受1Live采访时，有人问汤姆·赫兰德：作为一名蜘蛛侠粉丝，他心里最想问的问题是什么？他立即把话题转向了深受粉丝喜爱的蜘蛛侠角色迈尔斯·莫拉莱斯。对于迈尔斯何时加入MCU，他愿意给出明确答案吗？嗯，不愿意；但漫威那边似乎推进得很快。

paragraphs.en: "What would be the first question?" Holland pondered. "I guess it would be, 'When will we get Miles Morales?' would be the question I would ask – because I know the answer."
paragraphs.cn: 「第一个问题会是什么？」汤姆·赫兰德若有所思地说，「我想，‘我们什么时候才能看到迈尔斯·莫拉莱斯？’会是我会问的问题——因为我知道答案。」

paragraphs.en: When asked to elaborate by the interviewer, Holland said with a smile, "I'm asking the questions. I'm not answering them."
paragraphs.cn: 当采访者请他进一步说明时，汤姆·赫兰德笑着说：「是我在提问，不是我回答。」

paragraphs.en: The Spider-Man character has slipped past the MCU thus far, with Sony mostly keeping him locked away to the still-beloved Spider-Verse movies when it comes to his presence in feature films for the last decade. Holland said he had been working to bring Miles Morales into the MCU in June, and a few weeks ago, Marvel Studios boss Kevin Feige teased that the character likely wouldn't join his cinematic universe until sometime after the Spider-Verse saga ended .
paragraphs.cn: 到目前为止，这名蜘蛛侠角色一直没能进入MCU。过去十年间，就长片电影中的登场而言，索尼基本把他「锁」在至今仍深受喜爱的《蜘蛛侠：平行宇宙》系列电影里。汤姆·赫兰德6月称自己一直在推动迈尔斯·莫拉莱斯加入MCU；几周前，漫威影业掌门凯文·费奇暗示，这位角色很可能要等到《蜘蛛侠：平行宇宙》系列完结之后，才会加入他的电影宇宙。

paragraphs.en: It sounds Marvel has at least enough of a plan to share with its current Spidey star when it comes to bringing live-action Miles Morales to life, but does that mean plans for Spider-Man 5 have been ironed out? Not exactly.
paragraphs.cn: 听上去，漫威至少已有足够明确的计划，能够把真人版迈尔斯·莫拉莱斯的安排告诉现任蜘蛛侠演员；但这是否意味着《蜘蛛侠5》的计划已敲定？并非如此。

paragraphs.en: Both Holland, as well as his partner and Spider-Man: Brand New Day co-star, Zendaya, spoke about the future as part of a video with Serieously that was published two days before the film's July 31 premiere. Here, the question was a bit more direct, asking Holland if he would come back for a fifth Spider-Man movie should the opportunity arise. Holland said "we would love to" while refraining from getting too into detail.
paragraphs.cn: 在《蜘蛛侠：崭新之日》7月31日首映前两天发布的一段与Serieously共同拍摄的视频里，汤姆·赫兰德与自己的伴侣、该片联合主演赞达亚都谈到了未来。这里的问题更直接：如果有机会，他会不会回归出演第五部《蜘蛛侠》电影？汤姆·赫兰德没有展开细说，只说「我们会很乐意」。

paragraphs.en: "What is on the cards is a little unclear right now, but I'm sure that, whatever happens with Spider-Man, it'll be very bright and lovely."
paragraphs.cn: 「目前有哪些安排还有点不明朗，但我确信，无论《蜘蛛侠》接下来如何发展，都会非常光明、美好。」

paragraphs.en: Zendaya chimed in: "It'll be great no matter what. We'll be sure of it."
paragraphs.cn: 赞达亚补充道：「无论如何都会很棒，我们对此有把握。」

paragraphs.en: Spider-Man 5 has not been announced by Marvel Studios or Sony, but it would be a shock to see the story stop with Spider-Man: Brand New Day. The film is currently wrapping up a record - breaking opening weekend in theaters after it brought in an estimated $927 million worldwide . Should a fifth film deliver the right story and cast, it's easy to see a path where the classic comic book character continues to rake in impressive numbers.
paragraphs.cn: 漫威影业和索尼尚未宣布《蜘蛛侠5》，但若故事在《蜘蛛侠：崭新之日》止步，着实会令人意外。这部电影刚刚结束一个破纪录的影院首映周末，预计全球票房为9.27亿美元(约合人民币63亿元)。只要第五部找到合适的故事与演员阵容，这位经典漫画角色显然仍有望继续斩获可观的票房数字。

paragraphs.en: For now, audiences are probably happy with the film they have now, rather than a new one, which could be many, many years away. IGN gave the latest MCU picture a 7/10 review . Next up for the MCU is Avengers: Doomsday , which is set to premiere December 18, 2026. For more, you can read about what Feige had to say about the chances of Peter Parker meeting Venom in the MCU .
paragraphs.cn: 眼下，观众或许更满足于目前已有的影片，而不是一部可能仍要等很多很多年才会到来的新作。IGN给这部最新MCU电影打出了7/10分。MCU下一部是定于2026年12月18日上映的《复仇者联盟：毁灭之日》。如需了解更多，还可以看看凯文·费奇对于彼得·帕克在MCU中遇上毒液的可能性所作的表态。
